fomod.Name: TFCam
fomod.Author: StinkyPumpkin (original), CageTV (fork)
fomod.Description: A free camera overhaul for Skyrim SE / AE / VR (SKSE plugin, no ESP): camera roll, an attached camera light, time freeze, FOV control, screenshot keys, a cell-entry camera, the Scene Camera and the idle / furniture camera. The installer picks the TFCam.dll that matches your game version. Needs SKSE, the Address Library for SKSE Plugins and SKSE Menu Framework.
